newsitem.title: USA: Jan Bell Marketing adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Jan Bell Marketing adopts rights plan.

text.p: Jan Bell Marketing Inc said on Thursday that its board of directors adopted a shareholder rights plan to protect shareholders from partial tender offers and other takeover tactics.
Jan Bell said it will issue preferred stock purchase rights as a dividend at the rate of one Right for each share of common stock held at the close of business on December 6, 1996.
The rights plan, which expires November 21, 2006, will not prevent takeovers, but is designed to encourage anyone attempting to acquire the company to negotiate with the board.

Jan Bell said the rights only become exercisable if a person or group other than an exempted person makes a tender offer for, or acquires ownership of, more than 15 percent of the company's common stock.
The rights plan would enable the company to effectively dilute the interest of a potential acquirer if the rights plan goes into effect, Jan Bell said.

The company's board of directors will be entitled to redeem the Rights at $.01 per right at any time prior to a person or group acquiring 15 percent or more of the company's common stock, Jan Bell Marketing said.
